t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes will appear in predictable pairs, only the color matters, and each one will take you to either a bright or dark forest. The hat size and shape are not relevant. Pick the gnome that leads to the most productive forest.

vb_textbox.text: I hope you have a good wrist rest, because this is tedious.  The gnomes always come in the same colored pairs, and one leads to a dark forest, and one leads to a light forest. However, that doesn't really do you much good as the number of mushrooms keeps changing.  The hat style doesn't matter, just the color, because that determines what forest you wind up in--though that, in itself, doesn't seem to affect very much.
